title: Cashbook – Kaderblick documentation

hero.heading: Cashbook
hero.lead: The cashbook combines a team’s or club’s income and expenditure, personal balances and item catalogue. It only appears for accounts with the relevant cashier permission.

body:
Select a cashbook and period

If you manage several team or club cashbooks, select the required one at the top. The summary shows Cash balance, Total income and Total expenditure. On the Transactions tab, Year filters both the list and totals.

Transactions tab

Each transaction shows its date, description, category, income or expenditure amount and running balance. Automatically created entries may include references to personal-account payments, payouts or transfers.

Add income or expenditure

  1. Select Add transaction.
  2. Select Income or Expenditure.
  3. Enter a positive amount; the selected type determines whether Kaderblick adds or subtracts it.
  4. Check the date and enter a meaningful description.
  5. Select a category if required. Income categories include membership fees, sponsorship, donations, event income and fines; expenditure categories include match operations, equipment, rent, travel, association fees, insurance and administration.
  6. Select Save.

Edit, delete or export transactions

  • The pencil opens an editable transaction’s amount, type, date, description and category.
  • The bin opens a confirmation prompt. System-linked or already reversed transactions may offer different actions.
  • The download icon exports the selected cashbook as a CSV file.
  • Show more loads the next transactions in a long list.

Transfer between cashbooks

  1. Select Transfer. The button is active only if at least one permitted destination exists for the selected cashbook.
  2. Select the destination and enter the amount, description and date.
  3. Confirm. Kaderblick creates the related expenditure in the source cashbook and income in the destination cashbook.

A transfer is not deleted like an individual free transaction. Reverse transfer creates traceable counter-transactions with a date and optional note.

Personal balances tab

This tab summarises the personal accounts of associated people. Search by name or open a person’s detail row. It shows consumed, paid and balance figures and the individual entries and payments.

  • Add consumption creates a catalogue or free-text entry for the selected person.
  • Settle opens payment entry. Depending on the balance, a payment or payout is offered.
  • Enter the amount, date and optional note in the payment dialogue. Outstanding items can be allocated to the payment.
  • A personal item can be cancelled or supplemented by an adjustment as a credit or charge. An adjustment contains an amount, description, date and optional note.
  • A payment can be reversed; the history retains both the original and counter-entry.

Catalogue tab

The catalogue provides recurring items for personal-account entries.

  1. Select Add item.
  2. Enter the name, price and optional category.
  3. If required, assign the item to a team or club. Without an assignment, it can be offered in the permitted contexts.
  4. Use Active to determine whether the item is selectable for new entries.
  5. Save it. The pencil and bin edit or delete existing items.

Cashbook settings

The cog opens settings for the selected cashbook. You can change its name and opening balance. Changing the opening balance changes the basis of the displayed cash balance and should therefore be done only by the responsible cashier.

Billing & subscription

Billing & subscription opens billing for the Kaderblick service in the associated organisational context. This is separate from internal income, expenditure and personal-account payments.

Differences by role

  • Team cashier: manages the offered team cashbooks, their transactions, personal balances and items.
  • Club cashier: manages the offered club cashbooks and any additional permitted cashbooks.
  • Club or team administration: only receives this area when cashier permission is part of the specific assignment.
  • Players, parents, coaches and supporters: do not see the cashbook without cashier permission. Their own transactions are under My balance.
  • Super administration: a platform role does not replace selecting a concrete manageable cashbook; the interface follows the cashbooks provided by the system.

Related areas

  • Personal entries, payments and payouts also appear under My balance.
  • Assigned fines and rewards originate from the fines catalogue.
  • Team and club contexts come from Clubs & teams.
